summary: PRODUCTION E2E validation on https://alkobir.com — the correct custom-domain deployment (iter301's CORS blocker on emergent.host does NOT apply here — that was a bundle built against alkobir.com). UI login works end-to-end (مدير / PIN 123123, 2.66s to auth, 9.76s to fully idle dashboard). Session survives page reload. Test data (customer + vehicle + visit + approval) created via API with unique phone 0599999123 (fresh customer — no silent merge). All 3 QuickPrint document types (invoice / diagnosis / quote) opened in the UI, template resolved correctly to unified-{type}-a4-mobile-v1 (label shown in dialog: 'سبب الاختيار: explicit_document_template'), iframe preview rendered with ZERO raw placeholders ({{VAR}}/[[VAR]]) and TEST customer name + TEST-000 plate correctly substituted. PDFs downloaded successfully (~4.5MB each) and the print pipeline (iframe.contentWindow.print()) triggered. Security headers on alkobir.com are FULL (HSTS+preload, X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, CSP frame-ancestors 'none', Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection). Foreign-origin OPTIONS preflight returns 400 with no ACAO — safe. Unauth GET /api/vehicles and /api/auth/me both 401. CLEANUP: visit + vehicle + customer deleted (all confirmed GET→404); OUR test data NOT present in reports/journal-entries/vehicles list after cleanup. STAMP behaviour: BEFORE any approval → NO stamp images in either 'اعتماد العميل' or 'اعتماد الورشة' section (correct). AFTER a successful customer approval via /api/approvals/public/{token}/respond (OTP-verified, status=approved) → still NO stamp/badge/signature rendered in the customer section (approvals section HTML unchanged). This is likely a rendering-pipeline gap (vehicle-level customer approval-request records not consumed by the document template renderer) — flagged as P2 for main agent to confirm. Workshop approval flow was NOT executed on production to avoid journal-entry pollution risk.

Renderer does not query /api/approvals when building the document body — this is why customer-approval stamp doesn't appear post-approval. Either wire it in or clarify that public-response approvals are a distinct concept from document stamps.

rca of the issue: P2 STAMP RENDERING: The unified template contains {{CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_STAMP}} and {{WORKSHOP_APPROVAL_STAMP}} placeholders. The frontend renderer (evident by 0 raw {{VAR}} in iframe) substitutes them with EMPTY strings by default. After we approved via /api/approvals/public/{token}/respond → response confirmed status='approved' → but the section.approvals children are still empty. Reproduction: (1) create vehicle+visit; (2) POST /api/approvals with {vehicleId, customerId, title, amount}; (3) POST /api/approvals/public/{token}/respond with status=approved + valid otp; (4) reload /vehicle/{id} and open QuickPrint invoice; (5) inspect iframe.contentDocument section.approvals → empty. Likely fix: renderer must fetch latest approved /api/approvals?vehicle_id=… and inject a stamp SVG/img plus responder name+timestamp for the customer side. Similar wiring needed for workshop approval (probably from operations.workshopApproval or a runtime-approval log).
